name: Brushed X, blue
description: All bright blue: body, fin and engines. 'GLOBAL' in big thin white capitals across the forward windows with a white brushed X after it, a big white brushed X across the fin running off its leading edge, the G in white on the engines.

logos.description: The brushed X, big across the fin: a broad stroke rising from the root toward the trailing edge's top, ending in a ragged brush tip under the tip, crossed by one running down from the leading edge (off it) to the trailing edge near the root.
The brushed X after GLOBAL, a little higher than the letters and about as tall as their capitals.
On the right side the X comes first from the nose, ahead of GLOBAL, so the name reads GLOBAL X there too.
The G (a ring open at the top right with a bar across it) big on the side of each cowl.

titles.style: Big thin geometric capitals across the forward windows from just behind the forward door: the G a ring with a bar across its middle running out past it on the left, an A without a crossbar.
The same lettering on the right side, aft of the X so the name reads GLOBAL X (N570TA from below, 2025-03-13).

notes: Seen on N278GX (A320, left side, El Paso, 2026-02-04): the white scheme's layout (GXA/brush-x, measured on an A321) in reverse colors, its placement taken from there; the blue sampled from this photo. Also on N278GX in 2023. Not checked on a right side.
history: GlobalX's second scheme alongside the white one (GXA/brush-x) and the earlier blue and green swoosh (GXA/standard).
